verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single first-party line saying ChatGPT has user 'data controls' that apply to content it processes, including Computer Use screenshots. That implies a user-facing control over how conversation data is handled, but the pack never says these controls govern model training. The /memories controls are a separate, adjacent feature (memory reuse, not training) and are not credited. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a training opt-out toggle, its scope across chats, files and voice, its defaults per plan, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can control whether my conversations are used to train models

citations.quote: Your ChatGPT data controls apply to content processed through ChatGPT, including screenshots taken by Computer Use.
